paragraphs: BS&A Software builds municipal software for local governments and states that it has served over 2,100 of them since 1987. The software is meant to manage and operate municipal budgets, tax assessments, ordinances, contracts, construction and licenses.

The line is organized into cloud suites, beginning with a financial management suite for daily financial transactions. A utilities suite creates and manages customer, billing and work order information. Assessing and property tax are described as flagship products used by a majority of Michigan municipalities. The company takes on data migration itself, saying it has converted over 2,100 municipal entities. Cloud hosting runs through a partnership with Microsoft Azure data centers.

The company reports a client retention rate of 99 percent. It describes over 35 years of commitment to local government. BS&A says it has been recognized in the 2026 GovTech 100. The site also announces Jason Harrington as chief executive officer.

quote.text: BS&A’s local government software solutions are built on user feedback.
